text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is about to begin...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Every runner here is a capable opponent.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There are many senior racers
participating today
as well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
Think of this as a learning experience and give
it your all.

text_block_list.text:
I will. Winning here is essential if I ever
hope to
get back on track...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш looks ready to take on the
world. But
being her trainer, I'm a little
worried about
something else.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Um... Spe? Let's have a good race!
text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой

text_block_list.text:
Check it out! Spe and Rob Roy are
running! It's
been ages since they've
participated in a race!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They were on a tear a while ago,
but it's
seriously been a long time.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Get this, though! They've both won the
Japan
Cup before.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy's tenacity gave her a huge
following, and
there's so much power in
Spe's stride... This one's
going to be a
photo finish, I reckon!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Whoa... They're head and shoulders
above the
rest when it comes to
experience, huh?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
The classic racers sure have their work
cut out for
them...
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
There is so much speculation floating
around,
but...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will do what I must. I won't lose out to
the
seniors!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
